display_long_description:
# AN (ALMOST) IMPOSSIBLE CHALLENGE

 Solve all the riddles around a wooden box, pull or push levers and buttons, rotate wheels, and, most of all, use your brain. 

The box contains a remote to open the metal shutter and help you gain your freedom.

[media]

# So,  can you escape?

If you will, there's another challenge waiting for you: **The Puzzle Room**, where you'll have to crack 40 weird riddles written on an old piece of sheet and type each solution on a rusty computer.

[media]

Have fun, and good luck!
